description: End-to-end lifecycle management of APIs in a multi-tenant API Gateway, including design, routing, policies, deployments, runtime controls, and rollback.

api_id.description: Unique identifier for an API definition

version_id.description: Unique identifier for a specific API version

deployment_id.description: Unique identifier for a deployed API instance

tenant_id.description: Identifier for the tenant or workspace

environment_id.description: Deployment environment identifier (e.g. dev, staging, prod)

policy_id.description: Identifier for a reusable gateway policy

route_id.description: Identifier for a specific API route

request_id.description: Identifier for asynchronous or long-running operations

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: define_api
functions.description: Create a new API definition with base metadata, backend configuration, and initial routes.

protocol.description: Primary protocol used by the API

base_path.description: Base path prefix under which this API will be exposed

versioning_strategy.description: How API versions will be presented to consumers

targets.description: List of upstream targets for load balancing

backup.description: Whether this target is a backup only

initial_routes.description: Optional initial routes to create along with the API definition

methods.description: HTTP methods allowed on this route

upstream_override.description: Optional upstream override specific to this route

schemes.description: Allowed auth schemes for this route

labels.description: Free-form key-value labels for this API

functions.returns: Newly created API metadata including api_id and default version_id.

functions.name: create_api_version
functions.description: Create a new version of an existing API with routes and policy references.

api_id.description: Identifier of the API to version

source_version_id.description: Optional source version to clone from

version_label.description: Semantic version or descriptive label (e.g. v1.1, beta)

changelog.description: Human-readable description of changes in this version

prefix.description: Optional path prefix for this version

routes.description: List of routes for this version; overrides source routes if provided

route_id.description: Existing route ID to modify, or omitted for new route

policies.description: Policy references applied at this route level

order.description: Execution order relative to other policies

default_policies.description: Policies applied at version level to all routes unless overridden

functions.returns: Details of the created API version including version_id, effective routes, and inherited policies.

functions.name: configure_policy
functions.description: Create or update a reusable API Gateway policy with typed configuration and scoping.

policy_id.description: Existing policy ID to update; omitted when creating a new policy

type.description: Policy type determining required configuration schema

scope.description: Where this policy can be attached

environments.description: Environments where this policy is allowed

config.description: Arbitrary config accessible from the script

enabled.description: Whether this policy can be attached to APIs

functions.returns: Policy definition including policy_id, resolved config, and scope details.

functions.name: list_apis
functions.description: List and filter APIs available to a tenant, with optional version and policy details.

label_selector.description: Match APIs having all specified label key=value pairs

include.description: Additional details to include in the response

functions.returns: Paginated list of APIs with optional version, policy, and deployment summaries.

functions.name: deploy_api_version
functions.description: Deploy a specific API version to a target environment with traffic and canary settings.

deployment_mode.description: How this deployment should interact with existing ones

canary.description: Canary rollout configuration (required if mode is canary)

segment_definition.description: Arbitrary JSON for user segmentation rules

promotion_threshold.description: Conditions to auto-promote canary to full traffic

traffic_config.description: Static traffic configuration for non-canary deployments

base_domain.description: Domain or subdomain for this deployment

custom_domains.description: Additional hostnames mapped to this deployment

dry_run.description: If true, validates the deployment without applying it

functions.returns: Deployment result including deployment_id, status, traffic mapping, and any validation warnings.

functions.name: check_deployment_status
functions.description: Check the current status, health, and errors of a specific deployment.

time_window.description: Time window for metrics and errors

last_minutes.description: Alternative shortcut to specify a relative window

functions.returns: Deployment status including state, health indicators, error summaries, and recent events.

functions.name: pause_traffic
functions.description: Gradually or immediately pause consumer traffic to a deployment, optionally with a maintenance page.

percentage.description: Traffic percentage to pause when mode is 'percentage'

maintenance_response.description: Optional static maintenance response for paused traffic

functions.returns: Updated traffic state for the deployment and an operation tracking request_id if asynchronous.

functions.name: preview_routing_changes
functions.description: Validate and preview the impact of proposed routing or policy changes before applying them.

proposed_changes.description: Changes to simulate against a target environment

simulation_requests.description: Synthetic requests to test against the proposed changes

environment_id.description: Target environment to simulate, for env-specific policies

functions.returns: Preview report describing routing resolutions, potential conflicts, and simulated responses for test requests.

functions.name: apply_routing_changes
functions.description: Apply validated routing and policy changes to an API version with optional safety checks.

change_set_id.description: Identifier of a previously previewed change set to apply

proposed_changes.description: Direct change specification if change_set_id is not used (same shape as preview_routing_changes.proposed_changes)

safety_checks.description: Additional validation to run before applying changes

functions.returns: Change application result including updated routes, any warnings, and an audit trail reference.

functions.name: rollback_deployment
functions.description: Rollback a failing deployment to a previous stable version or configuration snapshot.

snapshot_id.description: Configuration snapshot ID when strategy is 'snapshot'

target_deployment_id.description: Existing stable deployment to shift traffic to when using 'traffic_shift'

traffic_shift.description: Traffic shift parameters for gradual rollback

reason.description: Reason for rollback for auditing and postmortems

functions.returns: Rollback operation details including new active deployment (if any) and request_id for async tracking.

functions.name: retry_failed_operation
functions.description: Retry a previously failed asynchronous operation such as a deployment, pause, or rollback.

request_id.description: Identifier of the failed operation to retry

retry_strategy.description: Configuration controlling how the retry should behave

override_parameters.description: Optional overrides to the original operation parameters to fix known issues

force.description: If true, retry even if operation is not marked as retryable

functions.returns: New operation status with updated request_id if a new retry attempt was scheduled.

functions.name: get_api_insights
functions.description: Retrieve traffic, latency, and error insights for an API across environments for observability and anomaly detection.

metrics.description: Metrics to retrieve for the given time window

group_by.description: Dimensions by which to group metrics

include_anomalies.description: Whether to run anomaly detection on the selected metrics

functions.returns: Aggregated metric time series, grouped breakdowns, and optional anomaly annotations for the API.

functions.name: export_api_configuration
functions.description: Export the full configuration of an API (definitions, versions, policies, deployments) for backup or migration.

redaction.description: Controls how sensitive values are handled in export

mask_patterns.description: List of JSONPath or field names to mask

target.description: Where to deliver the exported configuration

functions.returns: Export result, including inline configuration or a reference URL/location to the exported artifact.

functions.name: delete_api
functions.description: Safely delete an API and its associated versions and deployments, with optional soft-delete and safety checks.

delete_mode.description: Soft-delete allows recovery within a retention window

cascade.description: Controls how related resources are handled

confirmation_token.description: Confirmation token or phrase to prevent accidental deletion

functions.returns: Deletion outcome including whether the API was soft- or hard-deleted and recovery options if applicable.

functions.name: search_apis
functions.description: Faceted search across api records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for api_gateway_management.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of api records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_apis_by_status
functions.description: List api records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of api records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_api_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single api record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A api record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_apis
functions.description: Submit a batch of api records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_apis
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many api records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_apis
functions.description: Soft-archive api records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_apis
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of api records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_api_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for api lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_api_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created api event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_api_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a api including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_api_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for api_gateway_management with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_api_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a api_gateway_management operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_api_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled api_gateway_management job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_api_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a api_gateway_management execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_api_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a api prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_api_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a api for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_api_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending api approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_api
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached api to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_api_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a api.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_api_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a api with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_api_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a api and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_api_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a api (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_api_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for api_gateway_management over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_api_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for api_gateway_management.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_api_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed api_gateway_management behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_api_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active api_gateway_management policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.
